name: Story
rec: The most memorable of the set: the firm's story since 1998 told in huge type that lights up as you scroll, beside the real photos, now with cinematic chapter openings.
desc: The firm's story as a long-form magazine piece. A cover headline slides in line by line as the team photo opens out of a brand-blue square; each chapter opens with a giant number while the photo beside it wipes to the next; a sideways timeline runs from 1998 to the 2019 award to today.
fx: Cover headline slides in line by line as a blue square opens into the team photo
Each chapter opens with a giant number while the photo beside it wipes to the next
Big story text lights up word by word, with key phrases turning green
Sideways timeline from 1998 to the 2019 award to today
A client's words revealed word by word in huge type
Progress ring with the chapter name, and a cursor that shows the chapter number
